folds: Query-time forward 512-to-256 and 768-to-256 session splits; training queries strictly before validation start minus six hours; training targets censored at validation start before negative sampling.
relative_family: 12 tie-aware candidate-relative popularity percentiles and mass shares from six already certified fixed-cutoff history counts, before negative sampling
comparisons: shared minus each of five family drops
metric: 0.1 clicks + 0.3 carts + 0.6 orders, each sum(hits@20)/sum(min(20,true_items)); full validation candidate pools
continue_if: A challenger has positive pooled difference and nonnegative differences on both forward folds; prioritize expanded fitting-only replication. No automatic promotion or selection access.
stop_if: Checksum, schema, time-censor, group, native reload, or support failure; no repeated unchanged retries. No larger run for clearly regressing arms.
label_availability: Cart/order labels store first occurrence per item, next-click labels store first future click. Censor these positives at each fold cutoff; do not mistake maximum first occurrence for session completion. Training negatives are fixed-horizon, not full-period negatives.
interpretation: Small reused fitting-only diagnostic, not independent confirmation or comparable Kaggle leaderboard score; descriptive unadjusted bootstrap intervals. Model seeds and temporal replication remain open.
